summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature across four files, additively (864 insertions, 0 deletions): rich/progress.py (private _FileReader and _ProgressFileContext, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file, module-level open and wrap_file with a shared _make_file_progress helper), tests/test_progress.py (16 new tests before the __main__ block), docs/source/progress.rst (two new Advanced usage subsections), and CHANGELOG.md (one Added entry for PR 1759). Nothing was run: no tests, mypy, or import check, per instructions; all checks were by reading. Choices beyond the spec: 'tr' returns a binary reader because the spec says text mode is exactly 'r' or 'rt'; added a mode: str fallback overload on both open entry points; added name, mode, and truncate members so the reader stays instantiable on Python 3.6. Open risk: the TextIOWrapper(reader) call has no suppression and may need one under strict mypy. Changes are uncommitted.
